title: accounts
subtitle: money you hold across cash and bank accounts
formHint: name is optional. an account's currency is fixed once created. the starting balance is what the account held on your projection start date — to start over, set that date to today in settings and enter current balances.
currencyFixedHint: currency can't be changed after creation
excludeFromProjectionsHint: its balance, income and expenses won't count in projections. transfers between it and your other accounts count as money in or out.
interestHint: for savings accounts that pay interest every day. enter the rate your bank shows and how it quotes it. interest is added daily as income to this account, compounding on its balance. leave blank for no interest.
rateTypeTin: tipo de interés nominal · nominal annual (Spain)
rateTypeNamv: nominal anual mes vencido · nominal annual, monthly (Colombia)
empty: no accounts yet — add one to start tracking balances
interestEmpty: no interest credited yet — it is added each day from the day after you turn it on.
confirmArchive: archive this account? its history stays, but it leaves the pickers and projection total.
transferHint: a transfer moves money between two of your accounts in the same currency. it changes balances, not spend or income. projections only count transfers to or from an account excluded from them.
noTransferTarget: no other account in this currency
occurrenceLockedHint: date and accounts follow its recurring schedule
confirmDeleteTransfer: delete this transfer? both balances go back to before it.
confirmDeleteRecurringTransfer: stop this recurring transfer? past transfers are kept.
